title: Schedule of Dues and Dependant Rates, Resort Club Memberships
content:
Monthly dues of Resort Club Memberships are set per level for the primary member, with a separate monthly rate for each dependant beyond those the level includes. Members who pay twelve months of dues in advance receive the level's annual prepayment discount.

## Dues rates by level

| Membership level | Monthly dues of the primary member (USD) | Dependants included in the dues | Monthly dues per dependant beyond those included (USD) | Discount on twelve months of dues paid in advance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 129.00 | 0 | 49.00 | 8% |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 189.00 | 0 | 69.00 | 8% |
| Spa Club Membership | 259.00 | 0 | 89.00 | 10% |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 349.00 | 1 | 99.00 | 10% |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 499.00 | 4 | 59.00 | 10% |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 895.00 | 4 | 99.00 | 12% |

## Billing terms by level

| Membership level | Day of the month dues are invoiced | Oldest age of a child registered as a dependant | Months from the start date during which dues cannot rise | Largest dues increase in one membership year | Payment by automatic card payment required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |
| Spa Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 1 | 23 | 12 | 5% | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- "Dependants included in the dues" is a number of persons covered by the primary member's monthly dues without a dependant rate. The Beach & Pool Club Membership includes 1 dependant; the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership include 4; the Fitness, Pool & Fitness and Spa levels include none, so every registered dependant at those levels carries the dependant rate.
- The dependant rate is a monthly amount per person and is the level's own figure: 49.00 at the Fitness Club Membership, 69.00 at the Pool & Fitness Club Membership, 89.00 at the Spa Club Membership, 99.00 at the Beach & Pool Club Membership, 59.00 at the Family Resort Club Membership and 99.00 at the Founders Resort Club Membership.
- Dues are invoiced on day 1 of the month at every level.
- The annual prepayment discount is a percentage of twelve months of dues: 8% at the Fitness and Pool & Fitness levels, 10% at the Spa, Beach & Pool and Family Resort levels, and 12% at the Founders Resort Club Membership.
- The rate lock of 12 months and the yearly increase limit of 5% are the same at every level.

## Questions the schedule answers

**Up to what age may a child be registered as a dependant?** At every level a child may be registered as a dependant up to and including the age of 23.

**Is card payment optional?** No. At every level dues and charges must be paid by automatic card payment.
